title: REAL one-shot with Fable 5.2, Medieval sparring mini game
author: JahrudZ
selftext:
One shot of a medieval knight / sword sparring mini game using Fable 5.2. Pretty incredible how giving Fable 5.2 blender add-ons can make a big difference to the quality of human characters / animations. The game can probably be refined more but wanted to share a one-shot example.

Here's my prompt:

>Make a 3D sword-and-shield sparring game called "Knight's Training Yard." On a bright morning in a castle training yard surrounded by greenery, with banners blowing in the wind, a young knight spars one-on-one against an old sword master. The player can attack, block and dodge. The master telegraphs his attacks, fights back, and yields when he's beaten. The game should be in 3rd person POV and should feature 3 special attacks and a parry mechanic.
